title: X Hedging: towards an eXplainable artificial intelligence option Hedging framework
abstract: arXiv:2611.25870v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose X Hedging, an alternative to the Deep Hedging framework that addresses computational and explainability limitations of neural-network-based hedging strategies. Deep Hedging leverages neural networks to learn flexible hedging policies but relies on opaque models and typically requires large training datasets, which can complicate interpretation and limit its effectiveness in data-constrained settings. X Hedging takes a step toward addressing these limitations by replacing neural networks with tree ensemble methods, specifically LightGBM, to estimate hedging strategies. This design provides a computationally efficient alternative while preserving strong hedging performance and moving toward more user-centered explainability. translated_title: X Hedging：迈向可解释人工智能期权对冲框架
translated_abstract: 我们提出了X Hedging，这是对Deep Hedging框架的一种替代方案，旨在解决基于神经网络的对冲策略在计算和可解释性方面的局限性。Deep Hedging利用神经网络学习灵活的对冲策略，但依赖不透明的模型，且通常需要大量训练数据，这会使解释变得困难，并限制其在数据受限环境中的有效性。X Hedging朝着解决这些局限性迈出了一步，它用树集成方法（具体为LightGBM）替代神经网络来估计对冲策略。这种设计提供了一种计算高效的替代方案，同时保持了强大的对冲性能，并朝着更加以用户为中心的可解释性迈进。为了将LightGBM集成到强化学习风格的对冲框架中，我们引入了一种优化方法，该方法依次训练树集成模型，同时通过随机化引入随机性。
tldr: 本文提出X Hedging框架，用LightGBM树集成模型替代神经网络进行期权对冲策略学习，在保持对冲性能的同时实现了计算高效与更好的可解释性，弥补了Deep Hedging的不足。
en_tdlr: X Hedging replaces neural networks with LightGBM tree ensembles to learn hedging strategies, achieving computational efficiency and improved explainability while maintaining strong hedging performance, addressing the key limitations of the Deep Hedging framework.
